profile.description: 2026 review corrected: adult/21+ events are valid Adventure Zone prospects and must not be rejected solely because of age restriction or alcohol service. Adventure Zone previously emailed this event in 2023 and 2024. The current official Saratoga Hot Springs Resort listing confirms Oktoberfest on Sept. 26, 2026 from noon-3 PM in the Biergarten. Warrior's Playground may be the strongest adult-oriented angle; evaluate available space, event hours, route economics and package availability before outreach.

notes.subject: Correction — adult/21+ is not a non-fit reason
notes.body: Do not reject this event because it is 21+ or beer-focused. Adventure Zone can work adult events. For this event, assess Warrior's Playground and other competitive/adrenaline attractions first, then check footprint, operating window, route economics and availability. Prior 2023-2024 outreach remains relevant history.

followUps.label: Review adult-event fit — Snowy Mountain Oktoberfest
followUps.reason: Adult/21+ events are eligible. Check Warrior's Playground fit, space, route economics and package availability before deciding on history-aware outreach.
